repos.name: thedotmack/claude-mem
repos.description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More
repos.eli5: It works like a notebook that automatically writes down everything a smart helper does, shrinks the notes so they fit, and then shows the important parts the next time you talk to the helper.

repos.name: mattpocock/skills
repos.description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
repos.eli5: Think of it as a toolbox of tiny tricks that you can give to any robot assistant so it helps you build real things, like a set of LEGO instructions for engineers.

repos.name: Donchitos/Claude-Code-Game-Studios
repos.description: Turn Claude Code into a full game dev studio — 49 AI agents, 72 workflow skills, and a complete coordination system mirroring real studio hierarchy.
repos.eli5: It turns one AI helper into a whole pretend game studio, with different AI team members each doing a specific job, just like a real studio has directors, artists, and testers.

repos.name: pingdotgg/t3code
repos.eli5: It's like a remote control app that lets you steer many AI helpers on your computer from your phone or tablet, so you can code from anywhere.

repos.name: Renhuai123/ziwei-doushu
repos.description: 紫微斗数开源排盘引擎 — 基于倪海厦《天纪》体系，含完整排盘算法、四化系统、格局知识库、古籍原文数据
repos.eli5: It’s a computer version of an ancient Chinese fortune‑telling chart, turning birth dates into a detailed personality report, like a digital astrologer.

repos.name: milind-soni/OpenMausBot
repos.description: Open-source Grok Bot alternative with a virtual machine that bots can use
repos.eli5: Imagine a chat app where each contact is a different AI robot you own, each with its own personality and tools, letting you talk to many bots at once.

repos.name: pbakaus/impeccable
repos.description: The design vocabulary for your coding agent. Steer with polish and bolder, review with critique and audit, catch AI slop before it ships.
repos.eli5: It’s like a style guide for AI code helpers, telling them to polish their work, be bolder, and double‑check for mistakes before they hand you the result.

repos.name: obra/superpowers
repos.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
repos.eli5: It’s a set of simple rules and reusable tricks that teach AI helpers how to work together like a well‑organized team when building software.

repos.name: lightpanda-io/browser
repos.description: Lightpanda: the headless browser designed for AI and automation
repos.eli5: Think of it as a tiny, super‑fast robot web‑browser that can fetch and read webpages for other programs, using far less memory than a regular browser.

repos.name: HKUDS/DeepTutor
repos.eli5: It’s a digital tutor that learns what you need over time and gives you personalized lessons, like a friendly teacher that remembers everything you’ve studied.
